note: One word per idea, used everywhere in user-facing text.

terms.approved: Approved: site, slot and pin secured
terms.conditional: Conditional: slot reserved for 30 days while one item is completed
terms.on hold: On hold: we cannot decide until a detail is fixed; no slot is used
terms.waitlisted: Waitlisted: eligible, but another applicant ranks higher for the slot or pin
terms.declined: Declined: a hard rule fails; the message says how to re-apply
terms.withdrawn: Withdrawn: the applicant left; their slot goes to the next in line
terms.slot: A store the brand wants to open in a territory
terms.usable capacity: The smaller of open slots and free pin codes
terms.free pin: A pin code in the territory with no store of ours
terms.score: 0 to 100, from funds, experience, space, timing and location
terms.estimate: Our estimate of the money needed to open, shown with its arithmetic
